policy: At each support-window acquisition, select the latest stable minor and the immediately preceding stable minor within the current stable major; pin the highest stable patch published in each selected line. Retain existing previous-major compatibility cohorts separately. This is a library compatibility window, not an assertion that upstream maintains every previous line. Prereleases are excluded. Re-resolve on support-window changes, never relabel historical results.

families.note: npm publishes19.2.8 while the retrieved React versions page lists19.2.7. Exact registry patch and matching react-dom are used.
Vue2.7.16 remains EOL historical compatibility; it is not the rolling preceding line. Vue3.6 prereleases excluded.
Both Svelte5 minors use the same compiled legacy syntax adapter, with explicit property/event bridges. Runes-specific APIs are outside this shared custom-element contract.
